repos_data.description: Personal finance calculators for Claude and AI agents — mortgage, compound interest, FIRE, loan comparison, debt payoff. Zero API keys.

Free equity-compensation tax optimizer for AI agents — ISO/AMT, NSO, RSU sell-vs-hold, QSBS, concentration & hedging. Deterministic math, federal + 50 states + DC, multi-year plans. Remote MCP + REST, no signup.
Self-hosted, read-only MCP server for personal finance. Connect your banks via Plaid and query them from Claude Code.
MCP server for Chart Library — visual chart pattern search engine. Find similar historical stock charts and see what happened next.
Drawdown-first portfolio tool with a read-only MCP addon for Claude — a deterministic core computes every number; the AI is fenced out of arithmetic.
FinBrain MCP server: expose FinBrain datasets to AI agents (Claude, VSCode etc.) via SDK-first tools. Runs locally with each user's own FinBrain API key.
MCP server for calcnook — exposes 24 financial calculations to Claude Code, Cursor, Goose, and any MCP-compatible AI agent. Sharia-compliant, 7 countries. uvx calcnook-mcp.
FinData MCP — Financial data via Model Context Protocol. Live market prices, SEC filings, earnings, options flow, macro indicators.
MCP server for Trading 212 - portfolio analytics, order management, pies, dividends. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf.

MCP server (18 tools): NISA/iDeCo/retirement simulation, 28-indicator market snapshot, individual stock fundamentals (dividend/analyst), economic release calendars from 6 official sources (BEA/NY Fed/FRB/BLS/Cabinet Office/BOJ), latest BLS macro values (7 series), and geopolitical calendar + pulse.
An MCP server that provides real-time funding rate data across major crypto exchanges.
Financial Market Intelligence MCP Server — stock quotes, technical analysis, crypto data, and portfolio insights for AI agents
